steps.name: 'Little Handy'
steps.text: Reassessing. Biological safety of operating theater now at permitted levels.

steps.name: 'Little Handy'
steps.text: Surgery may begin at any time.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Hunters, just as before, you will be kept in a deep sleep during the automated surgery.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: I will also be manually repairing your outdated internal auto-adaptive junctions.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: This room filled to the brim with specimens, and these lab tables are all rather familiar. How long has it been since we last laid down in such an environment?

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Five years, Laurentina.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: I should really be waiting for your medulla replacement surgery to finish and your cell-Originium assimilation rate to stabilize before I handle any of your Hunter-related issues.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: But time is short, and I have no choice but to restore you to stable condition to the best of my abilities.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: My apologies, Laurentina.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Sentimental as always.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ah, right, as usual...

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: A candle will be lit by your side, so our little mermaid won't look so pale while she sleeps. I've asked my staff to prepare it for you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I knew you'd remember.

steps.name: 'Little Handy'
steps.text: Please maintain a comfortable position and stay still while the regen gel fills.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This isn't so different from back then. Except there's a lot less Hunters now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Clear a trench of scum, close your eyes, listen to some advisor prattle on, then sink into the regen gel and take a nap.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: And once you wake up, all the nauseating smells left on your body will be gone without a trace.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: While you were in the adverse, fickle environments of the land for long periods without care, your bodies became extremely unstable.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: The auto-adaptive junction can monitor your Seaborn genes, but five years of wear can render even the most precise instruments dull.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Moreover, your immune systems have also fallen into disorder thanks to their long struggle against the Seaborn genes.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: I will do my best to restore you all to peak condition, but anything lost during those five years is out of my hands.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Gladiia, our reunion at the tribunal was less than cordial, so I would have liked for us to consider this our first meeting since your return.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: But you haven't said a word since we started.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Is there anything else you need to tell us in regards to the surgery, Blandus?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: If not, then save it for after the procedure. We can discuss the changes we've felt over the past five years, as well as the changes you've felt.

steps.name: 'Little Handy'
steps.text: Please stay still. Anesthetic procedures will begin in ten seconds.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Well then. Sweet dreams, Hunters.
Advisor Blandus, some things have come up that need your reconfirmation.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Did I not say that once the operating theater doors have closed, I would be mending the Hunters' auto-adaptive junctions and must not be disturbed?
Central Control has discovered some abnormalities. You should personally check them over, just to be safe.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: ...Hold on then. I'll get the door.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: The monitoring units in the dome were performing an emergency scan. We noticed a concentration of algal bio-signatures here.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Thanks for informing me.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Not a problem.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Since you're already participating in Tullia's case, there was no reason to cut you out partway.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: A place where the dome and the ground meet... This former experimental field for road-side coral.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Though it can't compare to the specialized setups at the Institute of Ecological Art, it's much better for seaweed breeding than small-scale hydroponic tanks in a room.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Whether it be in her nature, or out of an ulterior motive, Tullia did not apply for authorization to use this space. She found it on her own, without telling anyone.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Tullia...

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: We can't say for sure if there is a Church hideout here, or if Tullia is still within... In short, stay alert.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Team 1 has already formed a defensive perimeter around the neighborhood, and will monitor the roads. Irene, go with Team 2. Enter via surface roads.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: As for the roads connecting the dome and the mezzanine, leave them to me.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Move out.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Sea Patroller
steps.text: Have you found something, Praefecta Secunda? Do you need reinforcements?
Somebody blocks her path. Or more precisely, prevents her from leaving.
The one in her way lurks in the shadows formed by the angles of the buildings, their entire body blending into the darkness save their eyes. Eyes that Secunda are all too familiar with.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: ...Stick to the plan.
Secunda cuts her comms.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: ...It's been a while, 'Magister.'

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: Blandus, the weapons technology advisor for the Waterway Program, and an expert in Class IV weapon R&D, correct?

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: ...You're not from the lab.

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: No sudden moves. If the bristles of this longbeard combtooth grass pierce your skin, you'll quickly fall into a tormented dream, where you'll sense your consciousness being slowly torn apart.

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: The variety used for euthanasia has been bred to be milder, but wild ones are still plenty cruel.

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: You may look half-dead, but I know for a fact that you're the sort who really cares how they die.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Church of the Deep?

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Don't you dare touch the anesthetized Hunters!

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: What an odd fellow. Even as your life is threatened, you think of them first?

steps.name: 'Researcher B'
steps.text: You may care for the Hunters, but you've never trusted the Abyssal Hunter project itself. You question its rationale, its damage to the nature of humanity, and all the sacrifice it requires.

steps.name: 'Researcher B'
steps.text: You took part in it, but only so you could personally control all the risks entailed.

steps.name: 'Researcher B'
steps.text: You experienced its demise firsthand; saw the extensive project, interlinked with so many others, come to a hasty end after an uncertain failure.

steps.name: 'Researcher B'
steps.text: So I doubt you'd want to send these survivors, freshly returned to Ægir, back onto the battlefield.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: No, you don't understand. What I do is only to protect them from further harm.

steps.name: 'Researcher B'
steps.text: So why not halt the procedure? Stop them from joining the battle for the Waterway Program?

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: The surgery is fully automated, I can't just stop it.

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: Sever the oxygen pipeline below the operating table, and it'll cut the procedure short. Don't think we don't know that.

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: If you won't do it, we can do it for you.

steps.name: 'Researcher B'
steps.text: After you finish 'handling' the Hunters, Advisor, come take a walk with us. Explain the principles behind the Class IV weapons, as well as how to shut them down.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Stop! If the operation is forcibly terminated, the Hunters will be irreversibly harmed—
Scum.
The 'researcher' stops in his tracks. He dares not step forward, yet dares not move back, for a lance has pierced his torso, his blood dripping down its shaft.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: If you do not wish me to ram this straight through your chest, let go of your hand.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Don't ask pointless questions, Secunda.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: You're investigating Tullia, too. Did you find anything?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: She is simply an ordinary data scientist who got caught up in this. She discovered something she shouldn't have. Attempted to warn the authorities, but failed.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You were too slow. What she encountered has nothing to do with her past.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The battle outside the city, the abnormalities within, the Sea Patrol staying uninvolved with the Waterway Program. You've noticed many oddities, yet at the same time, your attention was so easily diverted.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: You mean... Cassia?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You were once so focused, and keen as well.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: So the day you decided to leave the Abyssal Hunter Lab to join the Sea Patrol, I believed you had reflected upon yourself and chosen a more suitable path.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: It seems that was not the only time you have allowed emotion to cloud your decisions.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: ...Aside from your clothes, you haven't changed a bit in five years. Especially not how you talk.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Whether as a researcher or a Hunter, you'd never refuse to hear a student's questions, but would refuse to answer if you thought the question itself was wrong.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: There are no worthless answers. Their worth lies in the questions.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Questions are the most effective means of tempering your thoughts, and your questions were always most pointed, Secunda.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Then there should be no fault with my original question. What are you doing here, Ulpianus?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: This is the scene of a Sea Patrol investigation. A fugitive Abyssal Hunter like you should be laying down his anchor and making clear his position.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Gladiia and the others have proven an effective force in the battle for the Waterway Program, while despite also surviving, you chose to return to Milliarium like this.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: ...That's more than enough grounds to attack you.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Their return will only make the situation more volatile. Even through Tullia's case, it's clear that the so-called 'Waterway Program' is riddled with issues.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Ægir has learned nothing from the failure of the Abyssal Hunter project.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: What are you going to do?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Prevent this nation from sliding into the abyss.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: I'd say you're looking awfully like our enemy now, though.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Doubt me as you will, Secunda.
(Shrill crying)

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: What's happening in there?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: A ordinary Ægir, doing all she can.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: But Ægir will no longer show her any respect.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Who're you—?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Irene...

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Ulpianus?
Nobody responds. The Hunter has already faded into the shadows.

steps.name: 'Researcher B'
steps.text: What the—?! Why aren't you asleep?!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'm not the only one.
Hello. I suggest moving the hand carrying that whatever-grass away from the advisor's neck.

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: You—

steps.name: 'Researcher A'
steps.text: Arghhh—!
A fair hand tightly grips the plant held by the 'researcher,' its glistening tentacles struggling fiercely as they are nipped off one by one.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I told you to move it away.

spans.text: I told you to move it

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The real researchers are in the instrument recycling room, probably injected with paralytics. They won't wake up for a while.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I also took care of the goons in the corridor.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Did you leave any alive for questioning?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: They won't die before the Sea Patrol takes them away, at least.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Gladiia, Laurentina, Skadi...
Blandus stands in the center of the operating theater. The Hunters step towards him, over the intruders lying flat on the ground.
They do not lower their weapons.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Not going to explain the trick you played with the regen gel, advisor?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: *sigh* My dearest Blandus, just to be clear, we are no fortune tellers.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Swordfish thought something was off from the start.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We've undergone hundreds of surgeries. We've probably spent more time sleeping in gels than in our beds.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You should know that even if the operation failed to restore us to our full potential, we would still have returned to the battlefield.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: As I told Ulpianus when he came to me, all I wanted was for the participants of this program to live like normal people again someday.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: I wished for my fellow people, who'd come from all walks of life, to have the chance to finally return to their former lives.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Skadi could continue her life of wandering, hammering away at complex lighting arrays while taking pictures of the seabed nobody else would understand.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Laurentina's skills could let her become the next shining star of the Institute of Physical Art.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: We could watch the graceful stars projected across the dome, while she dances alongside the meteors in the Sophontheatrum.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Or perhaps we would find her works on the street corners of each and every city.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Flavius, the seaweed breeding technician. Nona, the songwriter. Lunia, the exotic organism researcher. And Celsus, the youngest ever scientific exploration fleet commander.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: We both still remember the names of all these Hunters, Gladiia. We've both had our fill of sacrifice.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: This is far from the first time I've heard this little cliché of yours.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Your feebleness and stupidity are already enough to earn you a death by my lance.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Luckily for you, those Church scum arrived at just the right time to save your hide.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Are you saying their actions have coincidentally proven my innocence?

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: That's not what I wanted, Gladiia.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: What I must do will not change.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Your innocence is of little relevance.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: My point was that by choosing to expose themselves now, risking everything to stop us Hunters from rejoining the battle, and even holding an advisor hostage...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: All it shows is how effective the deployment of the Waterway Program has been.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Blandus, weapons technology advisor of the Waterway Program. Abandon your little tricks, complete our surgery, then return to your original post.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Clementia's orders are that once Nest 37 has been successfully marked, the Class IV weapons are to immediately strike against all nests by the Waterway.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The Church is grasping at straws. As one can surmise from what those dregs were talking about earlier, they will not stop.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The Abyssal Hunter project no longer exists, Blandus. If sentimentality clouds your mind and renders you feeble, tear it out. Forget it.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: Gladiia.

steps.name: Blandus
steps.text: You're the same as ever. No, even stricter with yourself.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: What I ask of myself has no bearing here.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Just yesterday, out of two entire fleets, we were only able to save twenty-six people from the Seaborn encirclement.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Before we entered this old lab, I had just learned that those twenty-six legionnaires had already applied for positions in the newly-drawn army.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: War is never-ending, and no soldier can tear themselves away from the battlefield. That's all it is. Nothing more.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: ...Seaborn.
Where dome and ground meet, an entire wall is covered in remodeled hydroponic tanks. Various species of seaweed grow wildly, and several large clusters have already begun to grow out of their tanks.
Separated by a transparent wall, they face the gloomy seawater.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Muffled cry)
A lone Seaborn wanders about, like a lost spirit.
Its tentacles are tightly wound around a transparent container, and the rest of its body shakes and sways as it drags itself towards the tanks.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: (This clumsy posture...)

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: (As though it's unaccustomed to its body...)

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Are you...

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Tullia?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Tu—lli—a...

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: You can still speak. You still have your humanity. Tell me, what happened to you?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Left... and returned...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Data. Someone used... Waterway, signal...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: I told, her. But she...

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Told who?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Ocean... Fall into—ocean.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: City left. You. They're still... here...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: *whimper* So far...

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Give her some space, Irene. The Seaborn cells have completely transformed her body. Her mind is near the point of no return.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: We've handled similar transformations. This stage in Seaborn degeneration is extremely unstable. It's far beyond the point where we can provide palliative care.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: You sure took your time.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: I ran into something.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: We've been misled.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Someone deliberately engendered suspicions regarding the scientist's past and her motives for joining the Waterway Program. It's led the investigation astray.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: You mean that woman from the Institute of Facility Management.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: That's right. Cassia. Once we're finished here, the Sea Patrol will inform the Institute of Facility Management and arrest her.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Tullia noticed occasional abnormalities in the signaling system and told a friend, possibly Cassia. She exposed herself to the Church.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: She'd have been chased towards the fringes of the city, where she fell into a drain and was carried out to sea by the city's circulatory system.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Do you remember how we found pieces of biological tissue on our excursion outside? Crossing between two anchorage points without equipment is far beyond the limits of the human form.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: So in her desperation to return to the city...

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: She ate that strange flesh.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Muffled, indistinct murmuring)

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: What's that she's holding?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Plant nutrient fluid.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Her consciousness should be gone by now. Don't tell me she returned to the city just for these... seaweeds?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: 'These primitive seaweeds are some of the simplest, yet most tenacious lifeforms in the entire ocean.'

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: 'Whether in bright shallow seas, the dark abyss, the flat sea floor, or cracks in the cliffs, they stretch out as best they can.'

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: 'And they're as old as the ocean itself, pretty much this planet's living fossils.'

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Violent shudder)

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Pained wail)

The Seaborn suddenly stops, as though it has just noticed something. Its tentacles recklessly thrash about, and the transparent container tumbles from its grasp, spilling nutrient fluid all over the floor.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Bio-monitor readings increasing rapidly! Her transformation is accelerating!

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Why did she suddenly stop? Did something happen?
Irene walks in front of the Seaborn.
As she passes by the glass of the hydroponic tanks, she sees her own face.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Yes. I believe... she saw what she had become.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: ...A data scientist, yet also a woman as simple as the seaweeds she cultivates.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: She chose to stay, or perhaps knew that following the Institute of Ecological Art to another city would not truly have helped these seaweeds as they gradually lose their place out in the wild ocean.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: But now... she has become one of the pollutants threatening them herself.
Irene closes her eyes.
She never knew this Ægir woman who loved seaweeds. She's only ever seen her image in the Little Handy. And now, before their first meeting, she's already become the Seaborn she sees before her.
Whether by rapier or handcannon, she should end its life.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I believe she can no longer answer our questions.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: It seems you're familiar with this sort of thing.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I once heard a Seaborn play a broken song aboard a ship.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: I apologize for underestimating you earlier, Irene.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: The land and the sea are connected. You may not have experienced the frontlines of the Seaborn conflict, but you've witnessed both what has changed and what has not, equal in their weight and cruelty.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: But for now, let me handle this.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: She is an Ægir.
Irene sees Secunda walk past her side, stopping in front of the Seaborn.
The expressionless Praefecta places her shield between the Seaborn and the wall covered in tanks, then raises her weapon at the once-woman.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Wails)

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Her journey ended♪

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Her home close at hand♪

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: This song...

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: She chose this place to sleep.
The Seaborn collapses to the floor. The commander's shield blocks its spurting bodily fluids from entering the hydroponic tanks.
The seaweeds sway, quietly respirating.
